titre: Noter l'urgence de relance de chaque ligne d'un tableau
description: Le tableau des conversations en cours (CRM, feuille de suivi, boîte de réception) passe devant Jev ligne par ligne, avec l'étape, le dernier échange et le nombre de jours écoulés ; il rend une note d'urgence de 0 à 3. Le tri sur cette note donne la liste des relances du jour, les 3 en tête, les 0 hors de vue. Les délais de la grille sont ceux d'un cycle de vente court (services aux PME) : ajustez-les à votre cycle.

urgence.instructions: Rate how urgently we should follow up on this conversation. `etape` is the pipeline stage, `dernier_echange` summarizes the last exchange and who wrote last, `jours_depuis` is the number of days since that exchange.
criteria: 0, none: the deal is closed (won or lost), the contact asked to stop or said a clear no, or they set a date to come back that has not arrived yet.
1, low: the last message is ours and was sent fewer than 5 days ago, the contact is lukewarm, or the last exchange is an out of office; waiting is fine.
2, medium: the contact showed interest and has been silent for 5 to 15 days, a proposal or a document we sent has no answer after a week, or the contact said 'let me think' with no date.

3, high: we owe the contact something (a proposal, a call slot, a document, an answer to a question) and it is still pending; a hot contact has been silent for more than 15 days; a meeting or a deadline falls within the next few days and is unconfirmed.
